My next step is to find new times that work for both Elena and David and propose them to Alison. I need to find the common free slots in their calendars.

So, I have a new list of potential times. I will now add this to the shared workspace to inform Alison. This will be my third action. I will then end my session, as I will have completed my planned steps for this work session.
